Even if a kpop song has no english lyrics, as long as it’s good, just like this one, it’ll be successful.

Even though I'm in the US and I was a dancer/choreographer in my younger days, I appreciate SVT's choreos because they fit their style of songs (it's more Korean, less westernized).
